verses.en: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.
verses.pt: Depois me disse: Filho do homem, come o que achares; come este rolo, vai, e fala à casa de Israel.
verses.en_web: He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to me, Son of man, take this roll for your food, and go and say my words to the children of Israel.

verses.en: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.
verses.pt: Então abri minha boca, e me fez comer aquele rolo.
verses.en_web: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.
verses.en_bbe: And, on my opening my mouth, he made me take the roll as food.

verses.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
verses.pt: E disse-me: Filho do homem, faze com que teu ventre coma, e enche tuas entranhas deste rolo que eu te dou. Então o comi, e foi em minha boca doce como o mel.
verses.en_web: He said to me, “Son of man, cause your belly to eat, and fill your bowels with this scroll that I give you.” Then I ate it; and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to me, Son of man, let your stomach make a meal of it and let your inside be full of this roll which I am giving you. Then I took it, and it was sweet as honey in my mouth.

verses.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.
verses.pt: E disse-me: Filho do homem, vai, entra na casa de Israel, e fala-lhes com minhas palavras.
verses.en_web: He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to me, Son of man, go now to the children of Israel, and say my words to them.

verses.en: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, but to the house of Israel;
verses.pt: Pois tu não és enviado a um povo de fala estranha nem de língua difícil, mas sim à casa de Israel.
verses.en_web: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel;
verses.en_bbe: For you are not sent to a people whose talk is strange and whose language is hard, but to the children of Israel;

verses.en: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee.
verses.pt: Nem a muitos povos de fala estranha nem de língua difícil, cujas palavras não podes entender; se eu a eles te enviasse, eles te dariam ouvidos.
verses.en_web: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.
verses.en_bbe: Not to a number of peoples whose talk is strange and whose language is hard and whose words are not clear to you. Truly, if I sent you to them they would give ear to you.

verses.en: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel are impudent and hardhearted.
verses.pt: Porém a casa de Israel não quererá te ouvir, pois não querem ouvir a mim; pois toda a casa de Israel é obstinada de testa e dura de coração.
verses.en_web: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate and hard-hearted.
verses.en_bbe: But the children of Israel will not give ear to you; for they have no mind to give ear to me: for all the children of Israel have a hard brow and a stiff heart.

verses.en: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.
verses.pt: Eis que eu fiz teu rosto forte contra os rostos deles, e tua testa forte contra a testa deles.
verses.en_web: Behold, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads.
verses.en_bbe: See, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your brow hard against their brows.

verses.en: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.
verses.pt: Fiz tua testa como o diamante, mais forte que a pederneira; não os temas, nem te espantes da presença deles, ainda que sejam uma casa rebelde.
verses.en_web: I have made your forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. Don’t be afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.”
verses.en_bbe: Like a diamond harder than rock I have made your brow: have no fear of them and do not be overcome by their looks, for they are an uncontrolled people.

verses.en: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.
verses.pt: Disse-me mais: Filho do homem, toma em teu coração todas a minhas palavras que te falarei, e ouve com os teus ouvidos.
verses.en_web: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.
verses.en_bbe: Then he said to me, Son of man, take into your heart all my words which I am about to say to you, and let your ears be open to them.

verses.en: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.
verses.pt: Então vai, e chega aos do cativos, aos filhos de teu povo, e tu lhes falarás e lhes dirás: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS; quer ouçam, quer deixem de ouvir.
verses.en_web: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh;’ whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse.
verses.en_bbe: And go now to those who have been taken away as prisoners, to the children of your people, and say to them, This is what the Lord has said; if they give ear or if they do not.

verses.en: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, saying, Blessed be the glory of the LORD from his place.
verses.pt: Então o Espírito me levantou, e ouvi detrás de mim uma voz de grande estrondo, que dizia: Bendita seja a glória do SENHOR desde o seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be Yahweh’s glory from his place.”
verses.en_bbe: Then I was lifted up by the wind, and at my back the sound of a great rushing came to my ears when the glory of the Lord was lifted up from his place.

verses.en: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.
verses.pt: Ouvi também o som das asas dos animais, que tocavam umas às outras, e o som das rodas em frente deles, e som de grande estrondo.
verses.en_web: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.
verses.en_bbe: And there was the sound of the wings of the living beings touching one another, and the sound of the wheels at their side, the sound of a great rushing.

verses.en: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.
verses.pt: Assim o Espírito me levantou, e me tomou; e fui com amargura, pela indignação de meu espírito; mas a mão do SENHOR era forte sobre mim.
verses.en_web: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Yahweh’s hand was strong on me.
verses.en_bbe: And the wind, lifting me up, took me away: and I went in the heat of my spirit, and the hand of the Lord was strong on me.

verses.en: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel-abib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.
verses.pt: E vim aos do cativeiro, a Tel-Abibe, que moravam junto ao rio de Quebar, e eu morava onde eles moravam; e ali permaneci sete dias atônito entre eles.
verses.en_web: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv, that lived by the river Chebar, and to where they lived; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.
verses.en_bbe: Then I came to those who had been taken away as prisoners, who were at Telabib by the river Chebar, and I was seated among them full of wonder for seven days.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.pt: E aconteceu que, ao fim de sete dias, veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.en_web: At the end of seven days, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And at the end of seven days, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.en: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.
verses.pt: Filho do homem, eu te pus por vigia sobre a casa de Israel; portanto tu ouvirás a palavra de minha boca, e os alertarás de minha parte.
verses.en_web: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.
verses.en_bbe: Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the children of Israel: so give ear to the word of my mouth, and give them word from me of their danger.

verses.en: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
verses.pt: Quando eu disser ao perverso: ‘Certamente morrerás’, e tu não o alertares, nem falares para alertar ao perverso acerca do seu caminho perverso, a fim de o conservar em vida, aquele perverso morrerá na sua maldade, porém demandarei o sangue dele da tua mão.
verses.en_web: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.
verses.en_bbe: When I say to the evil-doer, Death will certainly be your fate; and you give him no word of it and say nothing to make clear to the evil-doer the danger of his evil way, so that he may be safe; that same evil man will come to death in his evil-doing; but I will make you responsible for his blood.

verses.en: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
verses.pt: Mas se tu alertares ao perverso, e ele não se converter de sua perversidade, e de seu perverso caminho, ele morrerá por sua maldade, e tu terás livrado tua alma.
verses.en_web: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”
verses.en_bbe: But if you give the evil-doer word of his danger, and he is not turned from his sin or from his evil way, death will overtake him in his evil-doing; but your life will be safe.

verses.en: Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
verses.pt: Semelhantemente, quando o justo se desviar de sua justiça, e fizer maldade, e eu puser algum tropeço diante dele, ele morrerá, porque tu não o alertaste; por seu pecado morrerá, e suas justiças que havia feito não serão lembradas; mas demandarei o sangue dele da tua mão.
verses.en_web: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you have not given him warning, he will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered; but I will require his blood at your hand.
verses.en_bbe: Again, when an upright man, turning away from his righteousness, does evil, and I put a cause of falling in his way, death will overtake him: because you have given him no word of his danger, death will overtake him in his evil-doing, and there will be no memory of the upright acts which he has done; but I will make you responsible for his blood.

verses.en: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.
verses.pt: Porém se tu alertares ao justo, para que o justo não peque, e ele não pecar, certamente viverá, porque foi alertado; e tu terás livrado tua alma.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous not sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live, because he took warning; and you have delivered your soul.”
verses.en_bbe: But if you say to the upright man that he is not to do evil, he will certainly keep his life because he took note of your word; and your life will be safe.

verses.en: And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.
verses.pt: E a mão do SENHOR estava ali sobre mim; e disse-me: Levanta-te, e sai ao vale; e ali falarei contigo.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s hand was there on me; and he said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.”
verses.en_bbe: And the hand of the Lord was on me there; and he said, Get up and go out into the valley and there I will have talk with you.

verses.en: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.
verses.pt: Então eu me levantei, e saí ao vale; e eis que a glória do SENHOR estava ali, como a glória que vi junto ao rio de Quebar; e caí sobre meu rosto.
verses.en_web: Then I arose, and went out into the plain, and behold, Yahweh’s glory stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar. Then I fell on my face.
verses.en_bbe: Then I got up and went out into the valley; and I saw the glory of the Lord resting there as I had seen it by the river Chebar; and I went down on my face.

verses.en: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.
verses.pt: Então o Espírito entrou em mim, e fez-me ficar de pé; e falou comigo, e disse-me: Entra, e fecha-te dentro de tua casa.
verses.en_web: Then the Spirit entered into me, and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.
verses.en_bbe: Then the spirit came into me and put me on my feet; and he had talk with me and said to me, Go and keep yourself shut up inside your house.

verses.en: But thou, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:
verses.pt: Pois tu, ó filho do homem, eis que porão cordas sobre ti, e com elas te amarrarão, por isso não sairás entre eles.
verses.en_web: But you, son of man, behold, they will put ropes on you, and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.
verses.en_bbe: But see, O son of man, I will put bands on you, prisoning you in them, and you will not go out among them:

verses.en: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious house.
verses.pt: E farei com que tua língua se apegue ao teu céu da boca, e ficarás mudo, e não lhes servirás de repreensor; pois são uma casa rebelde
verses.en_web: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth, that you will be mute, and will not be able to correct them; for they are a rebellious house.
verses.en_bbe: And I will make your tongue fixed to the roof of your mouth, so that you have no voice and may not make protests to them: for they are an uncontrolled people.

verses.en: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.
verses.pt: Mas quando eu falar contigo, abrirei a tua boca, e lhes dirás: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS; quem ouvir, ouça; e quem deixar de ouvir,deixe; pois são uma casa rebelde.
verses.en_web: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.”
verses.en_bbe: But when I have talk with you I will make your mouth open, and you are to say to them, This is what the Lord has said: Let the hearer give ear; and as for him who will not, let him keep his ears shut: for they are an uncontrolled people.
